'''2011 Belgium Regionals''' was a Players Committee regional, 4–5 February 2011, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Legacy Open]]). The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDF ([[:File:2011 Belgium Regionals.pdf]]).

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Site:''' Belgium
* '''Dates:''' 4–5 February 2011
* '''Winner:''' —
